source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Another difference concerns modification. Lexical compounds can modify nouns and are thus similar to lexical heads like adjectives. Syntactic compounds are ungrammatical in this context.
en: (i) I saw that old style house. (ii) I saw that former house (ruin).
